referenceFunction.generalComment: All data is referred to meter*year. Life time of the rail track infrastructure is assumed to be 100 yrs. Inventory for a conventional gravel track bedding.Data is refers to a two way track.; UUID: 2f8cf21b-3cfd-4836-9ab7-f68a607bb1ac
referenceFunction.includedProcesses: The inventory includes the disposal of contaminated gravel (20% of the total amount). About 80% of the gravel is re-used in other activities and thus a cut off allocation has been applied. Transport to disposal and re-use is accounted for with 200km. For diposal of sleepers a cut off allocation is made. Transport to disposal is accounted for with 200km.

timePeriod.text: Rail length is based on current statistical data (2000). The expenditures for the track disposal represent a recent high speed track in Germany
